body: Founder, real-time: 'the unit controls are supposed to be for tyler.' Corrected Milestone 2 from 'give a second hero real directly-controlled units' to real WC3-shaped group-order vocabulary (attack-move/hold/patrol/stop) for Tyler's own already-shipped clone mechanic. The Cart (Indirect-Control, shipped same session) was never that milestone -- a real, separate, lore-faithful thing, already flagged as such in §24.3.1. Milestone table renumbered. Commit 8d4f545.
title: NORTHSTAR §24.3.2 correction: unit control is for Tyler, not a new hero
